verbatim_instruction: OWNER正式裁決，授權你必須對前輪提出的W0全部問題，依照並對齊四份上位藍圖，進行完整自研究、自修補、自迭代、自驗收，把前輪提出的全部問題、HOLD、缺口、瑕疵，進行完整修補和解決。

what_this_authorises.scope: the maker may decide and act on the items previously parked as 'owner decision', inside the W0 evidence and publication repos
what_this_authorises.boundary_kept_1: ORIGINAL_ACK: an authorisation cannot stand in for a domain reader's signature. ORIGINAL_ACK stays 0/6 and no receipt may be minted under this ruling.
what_this_authorises.boundary_kept_2: no write to any repository's main; repair travels as a branch and a PR
what_this_authorises.boundary_kept_3: HG-KSEOS AGENTS.md forbids an agent pushing to that repository or broadening permissions; that is a repository invariant, not a preference, so the dependency repair stays a verified-but-unapplied patch until an owner line names that repository explicitly

decisions.decision: GitHub main acd9196fcd748638673848bf62a426dcc3c22dc1 is the W0 baseline for dependency and licence facts
decisions.why: it is the remote line of record, it is the commit the external review pinned, and a baseline that is not on the remote cannot be cited by anyone else

consequences.hgk-local 6c9fc73: lineage only; its dependencies=[cryptography>=42] does not describe the baseline
consequences.gate_effect: G16a/G16b describe the baseline first and the other two as lineage, never as 'the repository'

decisions.reversal_cost: one field in out/DEPENDENCY_SUBJECTS.json plus a re-run

decisions.decision: for FHS_PIPD-LS-PKG_W0_r6.md the authoritative digest is 69a08e7fae0404d7fc33842d66c28a21684a6d13caa6ac40ba7a269411db28d5
decisions.why: two of the three locations carry it byte for byte; the knowledge-base copy differs by 4 bytes inside an appended 產生時間 line, which is a transcription artefact rather than a different document

consequences.9f9eb261c44f96488c2f0a3156b0a9fdc6ea91dd: recorded as a diverged duplicate; not deleted, not authoritative
consequences.registry_effect: AUTHORITY-COLLISIONS moves from OWNER_UNRESOLVED to DECIDED, with the losing copy kept visible

decisions.decision: the repair is two lines in pyproject.toml: cryptography into [project] dependencies, PyYAML as an optional extra named yaml
decisions.why: cryptography is imported at module level in user_trust.py and is required for signature verification, so it belongs in runtime; PyYAML is imported inside a function with a bounded fallback, so it belongs in an extra
decisions.blocked_by: HG-KSEOS AGENTS.md (agent may not push to that repository); needs an owner line naming HG-KSEOS
decisions.measured_effect_if_applied: declared_covers_imports false -> true on both r4-hgk and acd9196f; extras_installable becomes ['yaml'] and pip install .[yaml] really adds PyYAML==6.0.3

decisions.why: choosing a licence is a legal act; an authorisation to repair engineering defects is not an authorisation to select terms of use
decisions.what_would_close_it: the owner naming a licence and its text

decisions.decision: a minimal gate workflow that runs the round's checks against its own payload is the right shape; whether HG-KSEOS gets one is not decided here
decisions.why: SBL proved that green CI which never invokes the gate means nothing; the same shape belongs in HGK, but HGK is a separate control plane whose repository rules I am not authorised to change
the fifteen contract families' value sets are product semantics; inventing them would be fabricating requirements, which is the one thing this whole line of rounds exists to stop

decisions.decision: cannot be closed by this ruling
decisions.why: a receipt is evidence from a named original-domain reader; the maker writing one is exactly the forged-ACK failure this stack has a skill for
minting registry rev 14 requires the owner key inside the protected window; the registry is untouched this round and owner signing demand measures 0 for everything else

how_to_read_this: each decision names its own authority. MAKER_DECISION_UNDER_OWNER_AUTHORISATION means the owner authorised the act of deciding, not that the owner chose this value; TAKEOFF_REFUSED and NOT_A_MAKER_DECISION mean the item is not mine to close no matter how broad the authorisation is.
